reviews.comment: One of the best classes I've taken at Texas A&M! Dr. Fuhrmann is among the top nuclear politics scholars in the world. His lectures are fascinating as their built on conflicting theories and views applied to real world situations. On top of that, he's a nice guy who is happy to help his students succeed!

I loved this class so much. I came in not knowing anything about nuclear politics and now I follow along with news and updates. Such a fun and interesting course -- only 3 exams and one final project so super easy/manageable. You have to go to class as he does not post lecture slides but the lectures are super interesting. Prof is awesome - TAKE IT
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is my favorite class that I've taken in college. Professor Fuhrmann is a fantastic professor and great lecturer. His class is challenging but fair. Show up to class, take notes, and complete the exam study guides and you will do very well. Assignments consisted of just three exams and one essay. You want an interesting POLS class? This is it.
